title: Recover from an interrupted manager run
item: /manage detects and recovers from a run that stopped partway: a stale run marker, the checkout left on a task branch, a task left In progress
motivation: A crashed or cancelled run leaves .git/manage-run-active behind, which blocks the owner's pushes and makes the next run-start fail, and can leave the checkout on task/<id>
notes: Today the owner deletes the marker by hand (SKILL.md, What the scripts enforce).
done_means: Given a leftover marker with no run going, a checkout on a task branch, or a task branch whose task the working branch still shows Ready, the next /manage start restores a state it can run from (or parks the task) without deleting a branch or losing a commit, and logs what it did in the run report. Tests in temporary git repos cover each case.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager build on 2026-11-15 at the owner's request. Priority left for the owner. How to tell a stale marker from a live run (e.g. the session id or pid in the marker) is the main design choice.
